title: Uyo Ane Zviratidzo Zvakapfugama Pamberi Pake Umambo
intro: Rwendo runoshamisa rwakamirira avo vanoshinga kugadzirisa chakavanzika ichi. Mukati memapeji eZvakazarurwa, paiva nemambo ane kusangana nemuporofita kwaizochinja rudzi rwose. Munhu uyu akatonga ari pachigaro cheumambo chiri kure, achitungamirirwa netsika dzekare, kusvika panguva inoshamisa yechokwadi chaMwari chakashandura mutongi nenyika nekusingaperi. Uchafumura here kuti mweya uyu unoshamisa une nyaya inovhara zvinoshamisa uye zvakadzama?
clues: Ndakatonga rudzi rwakapfuma mhiri kwemvura dziri kure, rwakakurumbira nekuda kweminda yedu neimba yedu refu.
Simba rangu raive guru, asi umambo hukuru hwakauya kuzopikisa kuvapo kwedu uye hunhu hwedu.
Shiri diki yakatakura shoko rinoshamisa, uye zvishamiso zvakatevera zvakaparadza zvese zvandaifunga nezvesimba.
Pandakaona chigaro choumambo chichishandurwa pamberi pangu, ndakaziva kuti hapana munhu anogona kuva nehunyanzvi hwakadaro.
Ndakazivisa pachena kuzviisa kwangu pasi paIshe Mumwe chete wedenga nenyika, ndichisiya zvese zvandaimboda.
Isu, serudzi, takasiya kunamata zuva kwekare ndokugamuchira chokwadi chakachinja zvese.

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
